title: English test meeting (en_long)
lines: Okay, let's start today's weekly meeting.
We have a few topics to cover.
There is a presentation skills course on September 2nd with 30 seats.
22 people have signed up so far, so there are 8 seats left.
Please send your names to Mary by Thursday.
Last week there was a small accident on the third-floor production line.
We have installed eight warning lights, and everyone must finish the safety refresher by August 15th.
The third topic is the firmware update for the power supply.
The reported problem is Bluetooth disconnection.
The fixed version is planned for March 15th.
Kevin will arrange the testing, at least ten rounds of regression tests, and we will run it on 100 units for three days before the full rollout.
The fourth topic is the customer order.
Lotus Tech wants 200 sample units of the power supply by February 28th.
They think the price is too high and asked for a 6 percent discount.
I suggest we sign a trial order of 30 units first and keep the new quote.
John will reply to the customer by Wednesday.
The next topic is the budget.
Next year's production budget is 800 thousand dollars, of which hardware takes 500 thousand.
We also need three more engineers.
Please send the budget sheet to finance by July 1st; Susan will handle it.
The sales team has three openings and we have interviewed twelve candidates.
We will hold three more interviews next week, led by Linda, and we hope new hires start by October 12th.
The next topic is the supplier.
Bright Optics delayed the battery delivery to February 7th, which is fourteen days late.
The alternate part is being verified and its yield is 92 percent.
Tom will confirm with the supplier and report back on Friday.
The next topic is the warehouse system.
Data migration is 90 percent done and the cutover is set for April 28th at night with four hours of downtime.
